Message.Name: System Event Message
Message.Description: The System Event message is used to communicate key market or data feed handler events.

Field.Name: Stock Locate
Field.Description: Always 0

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds since Unix epoch

Message.Name: Stock Directory Message
Message.Description: At the start of each trading session, Bruce ATS disseminates stock directory messages for all active symbols in its trading system.

Field.Name: Stock Locate
Field.Description: Locate Code uniquely assigned to the security symbol for the day.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Timestamp (see Data Types section for details)

Field.Name: Stock
Field.Description: Denotes the security symbol for the issue in the Nasdaq execution system.

Field.Name: Market Category
Field.Description: Indicates Listing market or listing market tier for the issue

Field.Name: Round Lot Size
Field.Description: Denotes the number of shares that represent a round lot for the issue

Field.Name: Authenticity
Field.Description: Flags whether an issue is treated by Bruce ATS as a live/production symbol or a test symbol

Message.Name: Stock Trading Action Message
Message.Description: Bruce ATS uses this administrative message to indicate the current trading status of a security to the trading community.

Field.Name: Stock Locate
Field.Description: Locate code identifying the security

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Timestamp (see Data Types section for details)

Field.Name: Stock
Field.Description: Stock symbol, right padded with spaces

Field.Name: Trading State
Field.Description: Indicates the current trading state for the stock.

Message.Name: Reg SHO Short Sale Price Test Restricted Indicator Message
Message.Description: For all issues, Bruce ATS relays the Reg SHO Short Sale Price Test Restricted Indicator message when it receives an update from the primary listing exchange.

Field.Name: Stock Locate
Field.Description: Locate code identifying the security

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Timestamp (see Data Types section for details)

Field.Name: Stock
Field.Description: Stock symbol, right padded with spaces

Field.Name: Reg SHO Action
Field.Description: Denotes the Reg SHO Short Sale Price Test Restriction status for the issue at the time of the message dissemination.

Message.Name: Add Order Message
Message.Description: This message will be generated for orders accepted by the Bruce ATS system and added to the book.

Field.Name: Stock Locate
Field.Description: Locate code identifying the security

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Timestamp (see Data Types section for details)

Field.Name: Order Reference Number
Field.Description: The unique reference number assigned to the new order at the time of receipt.

Field.Name: Buy/Sell Indicator
Field.Description: The type of order being added.

Field.Name: Shares
Field.Description: The total number of shares associated with the order being added to the book.

Field.Name: Stock
Field.Description: Stock symbol, right padded with spaces

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The display price of the new order

Message.Name: Order Executed Message
Message.Description: This message is sent whenever an order on the book is executed in whole or in part.

Field.Name: Stock Locate
Field.Description: Locate code identifying the security

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Timestamp (see Data Types section for details)

Field.Name: Order Reference Number
Field.Description: The reference number of the order being executed

Field.Name: Executed Shares
Field.Description: The number of shares executed

Field.Name: Match Number
Field.Description: The Bruce ATS generated day unique Match Number of this execution.

Message.Name: Order Cancel Message
Message.Description: This message is sent whenever an order on the book is modified as a result of a partial cancellation.

Field.Name: Stock Locate
Field.Description: Locate code identifying the security

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Timestamp (see Data Types section for details)

Field.Name: Order Reference Number
Field.Description: The reference number of the order being partially canceled

Field.Name: Cancelled Shares
Field.Description: The number of shares being removed from the order

Message.Name: Order Delete Message
Message.Description: This message is sent whenever an order on the book is being cancelled.

Field.Name: Stock Locate
Field.Description: Locate code identifying the security

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Timestamp (see Data Types section for details)

Field.Name: Order Reference Number
Field.Description: The reference number of the order being deleted

Message.Name: Order Replace Message
Message.Description: This message is sent whenever an order on the book has been cancel-replaced.

Field.Name: Stock Locate
Field.Description: Locate code identifying the security

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Timestamp (see Data Types section for details)

Field.Name: Original Order Reference Number
Field.Description: The original order reference number of the order being replaced

Field.Name: New Order Reference Number
Field.Description: The new reference number for this order at time of replacement

Field.Name: Shares
Field.Description: The new total displayed quantity

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The new display price for the order

Message.Name: Trade Correction Message
Message.Description: In the rare case that an adjustment to previously communicated trade / order execution, the Trade Correction Message will be used to communicate the required updates.

Field.Name: Stock Locate
Field.Description: Locate code identifying the security

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Timestamp (see Data Types section for details)

Field.Name: Match Number
Field.Description: The Bruce ATS match number of original execution

Field.Name: New Match Number
Field.Description: The Bruce ATS match number assigned to the adjusted execution

Field.Name: Shares
Field.Description: The shares associated with the adjusted execution

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The price associated with the adjusted execution

Message.Name: Trade Break Message
Message.Description: The Broken Trade Message is sent whenever an execution on Bruce ATS is broken.

Field.Name: Stock Locate
Field.Description: Locate code identifying the security

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Timestamp (see Data Types section for details)

Field.Name: Match Number
Field.Description: The Bruce ATS match number of the execution that was broken

Value.Name: Start of Transmission
Value.Description: Denotes that TotalViewITCH has started its daily transmission schedule

Value.Name: Start of System Hours
Value.Description: Denotes that Bruce ATS is open and ready to start accepting orders.

Value.Name: Start of Market Hours
Value.Description: Denotes the start of Bruce ATS Market Hours and orders are now available for execution.

Value.Name: End of Market Hours
Value.Description: Denotes the end of Bruce ATS Market Hours and orders are no longer available for execution.

Value.Name: End of System Hours
Value.Description: Denotes that Bruce ATS is now closed and will not accept any new orders.

Value.Name: End of Transmissions
Value.Description: Denotes that TotalViewITCH has completed its daily transmission schedule.

Value.Name: Reg SHO Restriction in effect
Value.Description: Reg SHO Short Sale Price Test Restriction in effect due to an intraday price drop in security

Value.Name: Reg SHO Restriction remains in effect
Value.Description: Reg SHO Short Sale Price Test Restriction remains in effect
